ACTORTYPE.DESCRIPTION: Configure death effect settings for type:
ACTORTYPE.TITLE: Actor Type

AUTOHIDE.HINT: Automatically hide the token after the death effects finish.
AUTOHIDE.LABEL: Auto-Hide

AUTOTRANSPARENT.HINT: Automatically set the token's opacity to 0 after the death effects finish.
AUTOTRANSPARENT.LABEL: Auto-Transparent

EDITTIMELINE.HINT:
Edit the death effect animation timeline.
See the wiki for more information.
EDITTIMELINE.LABEL: Edit Timeline

ENABLE.HINT: Toggle on to automatically run death effects when actor is taken out.
ENABLE.LABEL: Enable Death Effects

REMOVEEFFECT.MESSAGE: Are you sure you wish to remove this effect?
REMOVEEFFECT.TITLE: Remove Effect

SOURCE.HINT: Select where to store the effect configuration for this token
SOURCE.LABEL: Configuration Source

ACTIVEEFFECT.HINT: Trigger condition when gaining a particular ActiveEffect
ACTIVEEFFECT.LABEL: Active Effect

TRIGGERCONDITION.HINT: The condition whereby to automatically trigger death effects
TRIGGERCONDITION.LABEL: Trigger Condition

COMPARISONOPERATOR.HINT: How should this resource be compared against the given value?
COMPARISONOPERATOR.LABEL: Comparison Operator

COMPARISONVALUE.HINT:
The value to which to compare the actor's resource
This value may either be the path to a value on the actor, or a static number
COMPARISONVALUE.LABEL: Value

RESOURCE.HINT: Trigger when a given resource (such as health) is equal to or less than 0
RESOURCE.LABEL: Actor Resource

STATUS.HINT: Trigger the actor's death effects when gaining a given status effect
STATUS.LABEL: Status Effect

IMAGE.HINT: The image to which to change this placeable's texture
IMAGE.LABEL: Image

REVERT.HINT: If enabled, will revert back to the original texture once the entire timeline of death effects has finished.
REVERT.LABEL: Revert Afterwards

ANGLE.HINT: The angle at which to display this effect
ANGLE.LABEL: Angle

DURATION.HINT: How long this effect should last, in milliseconds
DURATION.LABEL: Duration

EASING.HINT:
An easing function to use when animating this effect.
See: GSAP documentation
EASING.LABEL: Easing

EASINGPARAMS.HINT: A set of parameters to pass to the easing function.
EASINGPARAMS.LABEL: Easing Parameters

LABEL.HINT: A friendly name by which to list this effect
LABEL.LABEL: Label

START.HINT: At which point during this animation should this effect start
START.LABEL: Start

CRUMBLE.DESCRIPTION: Cause the placeable to crumble into individual pixels

DIRECTION.HINT: The direction the placeable will crumble
DIRECTION.LABEL: Direction

FLOATDISTANCE.HINT: How far pixels will float away before dissolving
FLOATDISTANCE.LABEL: Float Distance

CRUMBLE.NAME: Crumble

BLOCKSIZE.HINT: The size of blocks to dissolve
BLOCKSIZE.LABEL: Block Size

DIRECTION.HINT: The direction to animate the placeable collapsing
DIRECTION.LABEL: Direction

COLOR.HINT: The color to flash the placeable
COLOR.LABEL: Color

FLASH.DESCRIPTION: Flashes the placeable a given color
FLASH.NAME: Flash

REPLACE.HINT: If enabled, will fully replace the colors of the placeable with this color
REPLACE.LABEL: Replace Color

GMONLY.HINT: If enabled, then only the GM will execute this macro.  Otherwise, ALL connected users will.
GMONLY.LABEL: GM Only

NULL.DESCRIPTION: Does nothing for a period of time.  Useful to delay the ending of the effect sequence by an arbitrary amount.
NULL.NAME: Null

OVERLAYIMAGE.DESCRIPTION: Put an image or video cip overtop the token

RELATIVESIZE.LABEL: Relative Sizing
RELATIVESIZE.HINT: If enabled, size or scale will be relative to the size of the placeable

SIZE.LABEL: Size
SIZE.HINT:
The base width and height of this effect
If relative sizing is enabled, these values will be added to the base size of the placeable

SCALE.LABEL: Scale
SCALE.HINT:
Relative size of this effect
This value is a normalized percentage with 1 being 100%.

ANCHOR.LABEL: Anchor
ANCHOR.HINT:
The position on the token where this image will be placed.
{0, 0} is the top left corner, {0.5, 0.5} is the center, {1, 1} is the bottom right corner

IMAGE.HINT: The image to overlay this placeable
IMAGE.LABEL: Image

OVERLAYIMAGE.NAME: Overlay Image

ANGLE.HINT: Angle in degrees by which to rotate this placeable
ANGLE.LABEL: Angle

DIMENSIONS.HINT: Amount to scale on the X and Y axes.  A value of 1 is the original size.
DIMENSIONS.LABEL: Amount

BACKGROUNDONLY.HINT: When enabled, will only flash the background behind tokens/tiles/etc
BACKGROUNDONLY.LABEL: Background Only

COLOR.HINT: The color to flash the screen
COLOR.LABEL: Color

SCREENFLASH.DESCRIPTION: Flash the screen a given color
SCREENFLASH.NAME: Screen Flash

SHAKE.DESCRIPTION: What it says on the tin. Shake the placeable.
SHAKE.NAME: Shake

SLIDE.DESCRIPTION: Slides the placeable's sprite in some direction

DIRECTION.HINT: The direction to slide the placeable
DIRECTION.LABEL: Direction

DISTANCE.HINT: Distance in pixels to slide the placeable
DISTANCE.LABEL: Distance

SLIDE.NAME: Slide

POSITION.HINT: If enabled, will cause sound to be played at this placeable's location
POSITION.LABEL: Play at Placeable

RADIUS.HINT: The radius at which the sound can be heard when playing at this placeable's locaiton
RADIUS.LABEL: Radius

VOLUME.HINT: The volume at which to play this sound
VOLUME.LABEL: Volume

SPRITEANIMATION.DESCRIPTION: Trigger an animation with the Sprite Animations module

IMMEDIATE.HINT: If unchecked, will wait until the current animation is finished before triggering this one.
IMMEDIATE.LABEL: Play Immediately

LOOP.HINT: If enabled, will loop this animation indefinitely.
LOOP.LABEL: Loop

SPRITEANIMATION.NAME: Sprite Animation

SOUND.HINT: (Optional) Sound on the above playlist to play
SOUND.LABEL: Sound

TEXTUREMASK.DESCRIPTION: Apply a mask to the placeable's texture

MASK.HINT:
Image to use as the mask.
See: PIXI documentation
MASK.LABEL: Mask

TEXTUREMASK.NAME: Texture Mask

TINT.DESCRIPTION: A simple efect to tint the placeable
TINT.NAME: Tint

REPLACE.HINT: If enabled, will fully replace the colors of the placeable with this color
REPLACE.LABEL: Replace Color

TINT.HINT: The color to use to tint this placeable.  Use white to return it to its usual colors.
TINT.LABEL: Tint

TOKENMAGIC.DESCRIPTION: Apply a Token Magic FX preset to this placeable
TOKENMAGIC.NAME: Token Magic FX

PARAMS.HINT: The parameters to pass to Token Magic FX
PARAMS.LABEL: Parameters

PRESET.HINT: Load one of the presets that Token Magic FX provides
PRESET.LABEL: Preset

FINALBOSS.DESCRIPTION: An animation sequence styled after Kefka's from Final Fantasy 6.
FINALBOSS.NAME: Final Boss

PURPLEDUST.DESCRIPTION: Turns the placeable purple, then they blow away like dust in the wind.
PURPLEDUST.NAME: Purple Dust

REDDISSOLVE.DESCRIPTION: Turns the placeable red, then dissolves it.
REDDISSOLVE.NAME: Red Dissolve

INJECTTOKENCONFIG.LABEL: Add tab to token configuration
INJECTTOKENCONFIG.HINT: When enabled, will add a tab to the token configuration application.

ACTORTYPE.LABEL: Actor Type Configuration
ACTORTYPE.HINT: Configure death effect configuration by actor type

ADDEFFECT.LABEL: Add Effect
ADDEFFECT.TOOLTIP: Add an effect to the timeline

CLEAR.LABEL: Clear
CLEAR.CONFIRM: Are you sure you want to clear all effects from this timeline?
